name: Traumermaid
source:
The main character, [url=/c124784]Kotarou[/url], returns to his hometown of Usahina for the first time in several years. There, in this sea-side town, he reunites with two girls from his childhood.

A mermaid-like girl, with a shy and timid personality, "[url=/c99445]Hinata[/url]".
A princess-like girl, with a strong and dominant personality "[url=/c99446]Tsubasa[/url]".

Loved by both of them, who will he choose?
Drown into the vortex of a distorted love triangle...

[Translated from the [url=https://enoshima210.work/2020/03/03/tm/]official website[/url]]
translation:
主人公[url=/c124784]Kotarou[/url]时隔数年，回到了故乡兔雏町。在这座海滨小镇，他与童年相识的两位女孩重逢。

一位是像人鱼般羞涩怯懦的女孩“[url=/c99445]Hinata[/url]”。
另一位是像公主般强势霸道的女孩“[url=/c99446]Tsubasa[/url]”。

面对两人倾注的爱意，他将选择谁？
沉入这段扭曲的三角恋漩涡之中吧……

[译自[url=https://enoshima210.work/2020/03/03/tm/]官方网站[/url]]
